content.text:
If you want to watch **MSNBC live online for free**, the official/legal answer is:

- **Official MSNBC live stream:** go to **msnbc.com/live**.  
- However, MSNBC says you must **sign in with a participating TV provider** for unlimited live streaming. ([nbcnews.zendesk.com](https://nbcnews.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45174673222931-How-can-I-watch-MSNBC-on-the-Internet?utm_source=openai))
- On Roku/apps, MSNBC offers **free clips**, but live streaming still requires a supported TV-provider login. ([nbcnews.zendesk.com](https://nbcnews.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45174673256979-How-do-I-watch-MSNBC-on-my-Roku-streaming-device?utm_source=openai))

**Legal “free” options:**
1. Use a cable/satellite/streaming-TV login if you already have one.
2. Try a live-TV service free trial that carries MSNBC, such as **DirecTV Stream, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, or Sling**—trial availability and prices change. ([tomsguide.com](https://www.tomsguide.com/entertainment/streaming/watch-msnbc-live?utm_source=openai))
3. For free live news without MSNBC specifically, try **NBC News NOW**, which is a free NBC live news stream on many platforms.

Be careful with sites claiming “MSNBC free HD live stream”—many are unofficial and may be unreliable, illegal, or risky.
